name: CLERHP Estructuras, S.A.
summary: CLERHP Estructuras, S.A. engages in structural engineering and construction activities in Spain and internationally. It offers structure design, calculation, and technical assistance in the construction and construction of structures; and rents construction equipment and machinery. The company also owns government buildings, wind towers, condominiums, houses, hotels, and other buildings. CLERHP Estructuras, S.A. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Murcia, Spain.
